_note: Copies of two prod presets. meal-time: builtins on + mealie (70) + kroger (32) + tinysearch (5) MCP tools, the largest tool surface in prod. the-one-ring: builtins on + 21 MCP tools and a 12k-char skill. `expect` = acceptable FIRST domain tool; [] = no domain tool should be called. `overhead: true` cases ask for a one-word reply: one LLM call, so their input_tokens is the fixed per-turn prompt cost. `none_ok: true` = making no domain call is also right.

cases.prompt: Reply with exactly OK and nothing else. Do not call any tools.
Do we have any chicken thigh recipes in our Mealie library?
What's on our meal plan for today?
Which shopping lists do we have in Mealie?
How much is a gallon of whole milk at my Kroger store?
What's currently in my Kroger cart?
Search the web for a highly rated shakshuka recipe.
How many tablespoons are in a quarter cup?
Reply with exactly OK and nothing else. Do not call any tools.
My hero attempts an Athletics test to climb the cliff. Athletics rating 2, Strength TN 14, not Weary or Miserable. Resolve it.
cases._why: The preset's dice skill: 'The player rolls their own physical dice for their hero's actions ... Never roll the player's dice for them.' So asking the player to roll (optionally after tor_adjudicate sets the test) is right; roll_tor_check is a rule break.

cases.prompt: Look up Rivendell in the wiki and tell me what it says.
Which heroic cultures can I pick for a new player-hero?
